normal_form: Suppose a 4x4 range R has all its SR<=2 vectors inside a hyperplane H, and some vector outside H has Schmidt rank 4. A local filter puts that vector at Omega=sum|kk>, so R = C*Omega + {(B x 1)Omega : B in N} with N=H. Then N has property (P): no B in N has a nonzero eigenvalue of geometric multiplicity >=2. The converse also holds, so (P) is exactly the range-criterion condition with core Omega. Rank<=5 is excluded by Part12 C31, so dim N>=5.
PT_zero_lemma: Let rho be PPT and x,y orthonormal with x tensor conj(y) in ker(rho). By KCKL Lemma 5, x tensor y lies in ker(rho^Gamma). The PT identity <a b|rho^Gamma|c d> = <a conj(d)|rho|c conj(b)> then gives <x conj(x)|rho|y conj(y)>=0. For R=C*Omega+N, x tensor conj(y) is orthogonal to R iff <x|B|y>=0 for all B in N. COROLLARY: suppose some orthonormal x,y also has <x|B|x>=<y|B|y>=0 for all B in N. Then <x conj(x)|rho|y conj(y)> = G_OmegaOmega > 0, a contradiction, so no PPT state has range R.
examples: (i) Every strictly upper-triangular N (any dimension, after U x conj(U)), taking x=|j>, y=|i>, j>i. (ii) A NEW non-nilpotent, non-triangularizable example: N5=span{E00,E01,E12,E23,E30}. It has property (P): for lambda!=0, rows 1-3 of B-lambda have the minor -lambda^3 on columns 1-3, so rank>=3. Hence any state with range C*Omega+N5 = span{|11>+|22>+|33>,|00>,|01>,|12>,|23>,|30>} would have SN>=3 by the range criterion. Yet x=|2>, y=|1> satisfy the corollary, so no PPT state has that range. This was checked directly: <21|rho|21>=0 forces <22|rho|11>=G_11=0.
